name: Sergeant major
summary: Three-player Whist-like trick-taking game where dealer, eldest and middle have targets 8, 5, 3 and first to 12 tricks in one deal wins.
rules_text: Three players use a 52-card deck. Deal 16 cards each, 4 cards form a kitty. Dealer chooses trump, discards 4 cards and takes the kitty. Eldest leads first. Players must follow suit if able. Highest trump wins trick, otherwise highest of led suit. Winner leads next. Targets for the hand are: eldest 5, middle 3, dealer 8. After 16 tricks, any player who takes 12+ tricks wins the game outright. Otherwise players go up or down by the difference between tricks taken and target. For next hand deal passes left. Before trump is named, each up player gives one unwanted card per excess trick to a down player; down player must return the highest card(s) they hold of those suits, or return the cards if they cannot. Then new dealer names trump and play continues with rotating targets.
